case_studies.title: Understanding the implications of artificial intelligence on field service operations: a case study of BT
case_studies.abstract: Abstract Driven by insufficient empirical research and understanding about AI deployment in operations management, we set out to explore the implications of AI on field service operations. Via an in-depth case study of four AI initiatives across a time span of 20 years at BT telecommunications, we explored the answers to the following two research questions (RQs): RQ1: How has the deployment of artificial agents affected the operational efficiency of the organisation? And RQ2: What are the criti
case_studies.summary: This case study explores the impact of AI on field service operations at BT telecommunications over 20 years, examining its effects on operational efficiency and critical success factors. The study provides insights into the deployment of AI in operations management, highlighting its potential to improve efficiency and decision-making.
case_studies.how_to_use: AI consultants can use this case study to inform their own deployments of AI in field service operations, leveraging the lessons learned from BT's experiences to optimize their own implementations.
case_studies.monetisation: The findings of this case study can be used to develop and market AI-powered field service management solutions, offering businesses a way to improve operational efficiency and reduce costs.

case_studies.title: From gut feel to smart prioritisation: Building an artificial intelligence opportunity scoring model that sales teams actually use
case_studies.abstract: In business-to-business (B2B) sales environments, the use of intuition and manual lead qualification methods over data-driven techniques frequently results in missed revenue opportunities, inefficient use of scarce resources and, ultimately, revenue leakage. This paper presents a hybrid artificial intelligence (AI) approach to predictive opportunity scoring that addresses the technical, organisational and cultural challenges commonly faced by B2B firms, such as low conversion rates and misaligne
case_studies.summary: This study presents a hybrid AI approach to predictive opportunity scoring, aiming to improve sales teams' efficiency and reduce revenue leakage in B2B environments. The model addresses common challenges faced by B2B firms, such as low conversion rates and misalignment, by providing a data-driven solution
case_studies.how_to_use: To apply this model, an AI consultant should integrate it with existing sales systems and provide training to sales teams to ensure seamless adoption and maximize its potential
case_studies.monetisation: The AI opportunity scoring model can be monetised by offering it as a SaaS solution to B2B companies, providing them with a competitive edge in sales forecasting and resource allocation

case_studies.title: Educational Integration of ESP32 Project-Based Learning with Generative AI: Design, Implementation, and Evaluation in Two Engineering Cohorts
case_studies.abstract: Microcontroller education is shifting from syntaxfocused programming to engineering reasoning under real constraints. We report a five-week, project-based and cooperative learning module using ESP32 with Arduino, where generative $\mathbf{A I}$ is allowed as guided scaffolding under mandatory traceability and individual oral verification. Two independent cohorts ($n=14$ and $n=15; N=29$) worked in triads with rotating roles and evidence boards. Summative assessment combined public prototype demo
case_studies.venue: Mexican International Conference on Computer Science
case_studies.summary: This study integrated ESP32 project-based learning with generative AI in two engineering cohorts, aiming to shift microcontroller education from syntax-focused programming to engineering reasoning under real constraints. The five-week module used cooperative learning, guided scaffolding, and mandatory traceability to assess its effectiveness.
case_studies.how_to_use: An AI consultant can use the findings of this study to inform the design of project-based learning modules that effectively integrate generative AI and ESP32 technology in engineering education.
case_studies.monetisation: The development of AI-powered educational tools and platforms for ESP32 project-based learning can provide a significant business opportunity for companies and educators looking to enhance engineering education.

case_studies.title: Safe and Trustworthy AI Framework (STAIF): Addressing Uncertainty in AI-Based Models for Real-World Deployment
case_studies.abstract: While artificial intelligence (AI) has great promise for revolutionizing many facets of our lives, questions about its ethical and long-term use still need to be answered. Recognizing the widespread impact of AI, governments have initiated legislation, with the European Union's AI Act and the United States' AI Act as pioneering efforts. AI's connection to sustainability factors, including trustworthiness, reliability, privacy and security, efficiency, and ethics, necessitates careful considerati
case_studies.summary: The Safe and Trustworthy AI Framework (STAIF) aims to address uncertainty in AI-based models for real-world deployment, focusing on sustainability factors such as trustworthiness and reliability. This framework is crucial for the widespread adoption of AI, considering its potential impact on various aspects of life and the need for careful consideration of ethical and long-term use.
case_studies.how_to_use: An AI consultant can utilize the STAIF framework to develop and deploy AI models that prioritize trustworthiness, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring compliance with emerging AI regulations.
case_studies.monetisation: The development and implementation of STAIF can create a business opportunity for companies to offer certified trustworthy AI solutions, capitalizing on the growing demand for responsible AI practices.

case_studies.title: Network Delay Measurement with Machine Learning: From Lab to Real-World Deployment
case_studies.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) continues to impact all facets of technology including Instrumentation and Measurement (I&M) with much effort spent on developing I&M systems assisted by machine learning (ML), especially deep learning [1]. While these ML-assisted I&M systems show promising results in a lab environment, there is always the question of how well they will perform in the real world. In fact, concerns about the real-world performance of ML is not exclusive to I&M but an inherent property
case_studies.summary: This case study explores the deployment of machine learning for network delay measurement, transitioning from a lab environment to real-world applications. It discusses the challenges and potential outcomes of using AI in instrumentation and measurement systems.
case_studies.how_to_use: To utilize this technology, AI consultants can develop and implement machine learning models for network delay measurement in various industries, such as telecommunications and finance.
case_studies.monetisation: The business opportunity lies in offering machine learning-based network delay measurement solutions as a service, providing companies with actionable insights to optimize their network performance and reduce latency.

case_studies.title: THE ROLE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN PERSONALISED MEDICINE: ADVANCEMENTS, CHALLENGES, AND FUTURE PERSPECTIVES
case_studies.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative technology in healthcare, significantly advancing personalised medicine. By leveraging vast amounts of data, AI enhances early disease detection, tailors treatments to individual patients, and optimises medical resource management. Despite these advantages, the integration of AI in healthcare presents challenges, including concerns over data privacy, acceptance among healthcare professionals, and the need for comprehensive regulatory f
case_studies.summary: Artificial intelligence is being used to improve personalised medicine by analysing large amounts of data to detect diseases earlier and tailor treatments to individual patients. Despite its potential, the integration of AI in healthcare faces challenges such as data privacy concerns and regulatory frameworks.
case_studies.how_to_use: An AI consultant can use this study to inform healthcare clients about the potential benefits and challenges of implementing AI in their organisations
case_studies.monetisation: The development of AI-powered personalised medicine platforms can create new business opportunities for healthcare technology companies

case_studies.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for Material Design and Engineering Applications: A Quantitative Computational Framework
case_studies.abstract: The advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) in material design and engineering has led to significant improvements in predictive modeling of material properties. However, the lack of interpretability in machine learning (ML)‐based material informatics presents a major barrier to its practical adoption. This study proposes a novel quantitative computational framework that integrates ML models with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques to enhance both predictive accuracy and int
case_studies.venue: International Journal of Mechanical System Dynamics
case_studies.summary: This study proposes a framework that combines machine learning models with explainable artificial intelligence techniques to improve the predictive accuracy and interpretability of material properties. The goal is to enhance the practical adoption of artificial intelligence in material design and engineering applications.
case_studies.how_to_use: To apply this framework, AI consultants can integrate XAI techniques into existing ML models for material informatics to provide more transparent and trustworthy predictions.
case_studies.monetisation: The proposed framework can be monetised by offering licensing fees or subscription-based services to material design and engineering companies looking to improve their predictive modeling capabilities.

case_studies.title: Artificial intelligence powered intelligent energy management framework for hydrogen storage and dispatch in smart microgrids
case_studies.abstract: Hydrogen energy storage is increasingly recognized as a key enabler for enhancing flexibility and reliability in smart microgrids with high shares of renewable energy. However, its practical deployment remains constrained by challenges such as real-time dispatch complexity, forecasting uncertainty, and nonlinear system dynamics. This study presents a novel AI-powered decision-support framework that integrates Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural networks for short-term forecasting with the Krill
case_studies.summary: This study presents a novel AI-powered framework for managing hydrogen storage and dispatch in smart microgrids, aiming to improve flexibility and reliability. The framework uses Long Short-Term Memory neural networks for short-term forecasting and addresses challenges such as real-time dispatch complexity and forecasting uncertainty.
case_studies.how_to_use: An AI consultant can utilize this framework by integrating it with existing microgrid systems and tuning the LSTM neural networks for optimal performance.
case_studies.monetisation: The developed AI-powered framework can be licensed to microgrid operators and energy companies, providing a business opportunity for revenue generation through subscription-based models or customized implementation services.

case_studies.title: AUBIQ: A Generative AI-Powered Framework for Automating Business Intelligence Requirements in Resource-Constrained Enterprises
case_studies.abstract: In today’s ever-changing data-driven environment, obtaining requirements for business intelligence (BI) systems remains a major challenge. This pain point is particularly prominent in small and medium-sized enterprises with limited resources: weak technical teams, high external communication costs and long response cycles make traditional manual specification processes more difficult to maintain. This paper proposes a new AI-driven codeless framework AUBIQ, which uses semantic search and large l
case_studies.summary: The AUBIQ framework uses generative AI to automate business intelligence requirements, helping small and medium-sized enterprises overcome resource constraints. By reducing the need for manual specification processes, AUBIQ aims to increase efficiency and reduce costs for these enterprises.
case_studies.how_to_use: To implement AUBIQ, an AI consultant can leverage the framework's semantic search and large language model capabilities to generate codeless business intelligence solutions for resource-constrained clients.
case_studies.monetisation: The AUBIQ framework presents a business opportunity to offer automated business intelligence solutions to small and medium-sized enterprises, potentially generating revenue through subscription-based models or consulting services.

case_studies.title: Multi-modal Language models in bioacoustics with zero-shot transfer: a case study
case_studies.abstract: Automatically detecting sound events with Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become increas- ingly popular in the field of bioacoustics, ecoacoustics, and soundscape ecology, particularly for wildlife monitoring and conservation. Conventional methods predominantly employ supervised learning techniques that depend on substantial amounts of manually annotated bioacoustic data. However, manual annotation in bioacoustics is tremendously resource- intensive in terms of both human labor and financial re
case_studies.summary: This case study explores the use of multi-modal language models in bioacoustics to automatically detect sound events, which can aid in wildlife monitoring and conservation. The approach utilizes zero-shot transfer, eliminating the need for large amounts of manually annotated bioacoustic data.
case_studies.how_to_use: To apply this technology, an AI consultant can use pre-trained language models and fine-tune them on bioacoustic datasets to develop accurate sound event detection systems.
case_studies.monetisation: The technology can be monetized by offering automated sound event detection services to conservation organizations and research institutions, potentially reducing their manual annotation costs and increasing monitoring efficiency.

case_studies.title: Evaluation of Generative AI Chatbot Models for Handling Critical Situations in Business Information Systems Implementation: A Case Study
case_studies.abstract: This paper presents the possibilities for applying generative AI chatbot models (GenAI), in particular large language models (LLM), in the practice of implementing Business Information Systems (BIS). The study included popular GenAI and students studying similar disciplines. The goal is to assess the quality of the responses of the chatbots and students to a real case study from practice related to the implementation of BIS. As a result of the study, it was found that GenAI can be a good assista
case_studies.summary: This case study evaluates the use of generative AI chatbot models in implementing Business Information Systems, comparing their responses to those of students in similar disciplines. The study found that generative AI can be a good assistant in handling critical situations in BIS implementation.
case_studies.how_to_use: AI consultants can use generative AI chatbot models as a tool to assist in handling complex situations in Business Information Systems implementation.
case_studies.monetisation: Businesses can leverage generative AI chatbot models to reduce implementation costs and improve efficiency in Business Information Systems, creating a potential revenue stream.

case_studies.title: Application and Challenges of Artificial Intelligence in Human Resource Management
case_studies.abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into human resource management (HRM) presents a transformative opportunity to enhance efficiency, improve decision-making, and address ethical concerns. This research examines the current state of AI applications in HRM, identifying key benefits and challenges associated with implementation. It develops a framework for ethical and responsible AI deployment, considering concerns about bias, privacy, and job displacement. By analyzing real-world case
case_studies.venue: Frontiers in Business, Economics and Management
case_studies.summary: This research explores the application of artificial intelligence in human resource management, highlighting its potential to improve efficiency and decision-making, while also addressing ethical concerns. The study develops a framework for responsible AI deployment in HRM, considering issues like bias, privacy, and job displacement.
case_studies.how_to_use: An AI consultant can use this research to inform the development of tailored AI solutions for HRM clients, prioritizing ethical considerations and responsible implementation.
case_studies.monetisation: Businesses can capitalize on the growing demand for AI-powered HRM solutions by developing and marketing ethical AI tools that address the challenges and concerns identified in this research.

case_studies.title: Exploring the Role of Social Support When Integrating Generative AI in Small Business Workflows
case_studies.abstract: Small business owners stand to benefit from generative AI technologies due to limited resources, yet they must navigate increasing legal and ethical risks. In this paper, we interview 11 entrepreneurs and support personnel to investigate existing practices of how entrepreneurs integrate generative AI technologies into their business workflows. Specifically, we build on scholarship in HCI which emphasizes the role of small, offline networks in supporting entrepreneurs' technology maintenance. We
case_studies.summary: This study explores how small business owners integrate generative AI into their workflows, highlighting the importance of social support in navigating legal and ethical risks. The research findings are based on interviews with 11 entrepreneurs and support personnel, shedding light on existing practices and challenges.
case_studies.how_to_use: AI consultants can use the insights from this study to develop targeted support services for small business owners looking to adopt generative AI technologies.
case_studies.monetisation: The findings of this study can be monetised by developing and marketing tailored AI solutions and support packages for small businesses, addressing their specific needs and pain points.

case_studies.title: Leveraging Generative AI Tools Like ChatGPT for Startups and Small Business Growth
case_studies.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming the way businesses operate, especially with the advent of generative AI tools such as OpenAI's ChatGPT. These cutting-edge technologies offer an array of opportunities for startups and small businesses to optimize their processes, enhance customer engagement, and drive growth. This article delves into the world of generative AI, highlighting its potential applications, opportunities, and risks, and concludes with practical steps entrepreneurs can take
case_studies.summary: This case study explores the potential of generative AI tools like ChatGPT to drive growth for startups and small businesses by optimizing processes and enhancing customer engagement. It highlights the opportunities and risks of adopting these technologies and provides practical steps for entrepreneurs to leverage them
case_studies.how_to_use: AI consultants can use this study to advise clients on implementing generative AI tools to streamline operations and improve customer interactions
case_studies.monetisation: Businesses can monetise generative AI by offering tailored solutions and services that utilise ChatGPT and similar tools to enhance customer experience and drive revenue

case_studies.title: Generative AI in Business: Visual Illustrations of Applications and Insights from Q1 2025
case_studies.abstract: This paper explores the current applications, benefits, and challenges of generative AI in various business do- mains, drawing from recent literature and industry reports from literature published in 2025. We examine key use cases including content creation, knowledge management, business process automation, and decision support. The paper also discusses implementation challenges, ethical considerations, and future directions for generative AI adoption in business contexts. We analyze key applic
case_studies.summary: This paper explores the applications and challenges of generative AI in business, including content creation and decision support, and discusses its potential benefits and future directions. The study provides insights into the current state of generative AI adoption in various business domains, but does not provide specific measurable outcomes
case_studies.how_to_use: An AI consultant can use this paper as a starting point to identify potential use cases for generative AI in their clients' businesses and develop strategies for implementation
case_studies.monetisation: Businesses can leverage the insights from this paper to develop and market generative AI-based solutions and services, such as automated content creation and decision support tools, to other companies

case_studies.title: A Framework for Implementing Generative AI in Business Processes
case_studies.abstract: The subject of the research is the development of a comprehensive framework for the strategic implementation of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in the business processes of organizations of various sizes and industries. Existing approaches to the implementation of traditional artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, GenAI, and digital transformation are analyzed, and their limitations and shortcomings are identified in the context of the specific characteristics of GenAI models, s
case_studies.summary: This research aims to develop a framework for implementing generative artificial intelligence in business processes, addressing the limitations of existing approaches. The framework is designed to be applicable to organizations of various sizes and industries, but its practical impact and implementation status are unclear.
case_studies.how_to_use: An AI consultant can use this research as a starting point to develop tailored implementation strategies for generative AI in their clients' business processes.
case_studies.monetisation: Businesses can capitalize on the potential of generative AI by developing and marketing implementation frameworks and consulting services based on this research.

case_studies.title: Advancing Financial Inclusion for Small and Medium Enterprises through Generative AI Frameworks in the United States
case_studies.abstract:
Aim: This study examines the role of generative AI in enhancing financial inclusion among Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the United States. It explores the potential of AI- driven frameworks in mitigating financial constraints, improving credit accessibility, and streamlining financial processes for SMEs. 
Study Design: A systematic review of literature published between 2019 and 2024 was conducted to assess the impact of generative AI technologies on financial services for SMEs. The stu
case_studies.venue: Asian Journal of Economics Business and Accounting
case_studies.summary: This study explores the potential of generative AI in improving financial inclusion for Small and Medium Enterprises in the United States by streamlining financial processes and enhancing credit accessibility. The research aims to identify the impact of AI-driven frameworks on mitigating financial constraints for SMEs.
case_studies.how_to_use: An AI consultant can use the findings of this study to develop AI-driven solutions for SMEs, such as credit scoring models and financial process automation tools, to improve their financial inclusion.
case_studies.monetisation: The research findings can be monetised by developing and licensing AI-powered financial platforms for SMEs, offering a new revenue stream for financial institutions and fintech companies.

case_studies.title: Ethical Implications of Generative AI in Business Decision-Making: A Governance Perspective
case_studies.abstract: The rapid integration of generative artificial intelligence (AI) into business decision-making has introduced unprecedented ethical challenges for which existing governance frameworks are insufficient. This study investigates these challenges by conducting a literature review and framework analysis focused on the ethical implications of generative AI in corporate contexts. Key findings reveal significant algorithmic risks including bias, transparency deficits, privacy violations, and autonomy er
case_studies.venue: International Journal of Business and Applied Social Science
case_studies.summary: This study explores the ethical challenges of using generative AI in business decision-making and identifies key risks such as bias and transparency deficits. The research aims to inform the development of more effective governance frameworks for AI adoption in corporate contexts.
case_studies.how_to_use: AI consultants can use the findings of this study to advise clients on the ethical implications of generative AI and develop strategies to mitigate associated risks.
case_studies.monetisation: Businesses can capitalize on the growing demand for AI ethics consulting services by developing and marketing tailored solutions to address the ethical challenges of generative AI in corporate decision-making.
